correctness.rationale: The bidegree (3,4), graph metric, signed internal deletion differential, 13+13 vertices and endpoint decomposition are explicit. Independent fresh exact reconstruction of the F_3 projective incidence graph gave 26 equal-endpoint blocks (C2,C3,C4)=(12,36,28), boundary ranks (12,24) and zero H3; for representative distinct same-type endpoints it gave (17,45,19), ranks (17,19), H3 rank 9, with all tested Smith factors units. Incidence symmetries transfer the two endpoint profiles. A separate direct enumeration of normalized invertible 3x3 matrices established 5616 projectivities and the ordered point-plus-line triangle permutation character (2808:1,72:117,0:5498). Source code further identifies the magnitude chain Euler trace using a diagonal 104-generator basis and checks the projective group; equality of rational characters plus polarity trace zero proves the rational module. The integral explicit basis for distinct endpoints is prior work; the fresh q=3 equal-endpoint vanishing closes the total representation.
residual_risks: Our independent Smith and character checks concern the fixed q=3 graph, not uniform projective planes; published diagonal rank/trace theorem is used as stated. No integral equivariant basis for the total q=3 group is claimed by this record.
